Liam Fitzgerald  
Email: l.fitzgerald@capitalflowsolutions.com | Phone: +31 6 1234 5678 | Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/fitzgerald-liam  

As a Staff ML Engineer - AI Systems Architect at CapitalFlow Solutions, I’ve designed scalable AI systems that drive enterprise value across fintech. My career spans 13 years of delivering impactful machine learning solutions, with a focus on operationalizing complex models at scale. I’ve led MLOps transformations, optimized cloud infrastructure, and pioneered AI-driven product innovation. My work has directly influenced revenue growth, cost reduction, and risk mitigation for global financial institutions.  

At CapitalFlow Solutions, I lead the architecture of AI systems that power real-time fraud detection, credit scoring, and market analytics. My team’s models have reduced false positives by 40% in fraud detection while maintaining 99.2% precision, a metric I refined during my tenure at FinTech Innovators Inc. I’ve also spearheaded the deployment of large-scale NLP models that automate customer service workflows, cutting operational costs by 30% in two major European markets.  

My career began at FinTech Innovators Inc., where I built a fraud detection system using TensorFlow that processed 10 million transactions daily. This model’s precision of 99.2% outperformed legacy systems, earning recognition as a benchmark for the industry. Later, at ValueStream Analytics, I architected real-time trading algorithms using PyTorch, which increased ROI by 22% through predictive analytics. At GlobalFinTech Ltd., I scaled MLOps pipelines across 12 regions, reducing model deployment time by 65% and establishing a framework for continuous model improvement.  

Technical Skills:  
- **TensorFlow**: Led the deployment of production-grade fraud detection models with 99.2% precision, integrating them into distributed systems. Mentored teams on model optimization and serving strategies.  
- **PyTorch**: Designed the backbone of a real-time trading platform used by 500+ institutions, achieving 22% ROI improvements through deep learning.  
- **Model Deployment**: Engineered CI/CD pipelines for TensorFlow and PyTorch models, reducing deployment latency from hours to minutes.  
- **MLOps (MLflow/W&B)**: Architectured end-to-end MLOps systems, integrating model versioning, monitoring, and logging for 12+ regions.  
- **LLMs/Prompt Engineering**: Developed a proprietary chatbot for financial advisors, achieving 85% user satisfaction through iterative prompt optimization.  
- **NLP**: Built a multilingual sentiment analysis system that processed 500K daily transactions, improving customer service response times by 40%.  
- **Cloud Cost Optimization**: Reduced AWS infrastructure costs by 25% through resource allocation strategies and spot instance utilization.  
- **Data Warehousing**: Designed ETL pipelines for a data warehouse that aggregated 10TB of transactional data monthly, enabling real-time analytics.  
- **Infrastructure as Code**: Automated provisioning of ML environments using Terraform, ensuring consistency across 15+ global data centers.  

Projects:  
- **Global Fraud Detection System**: Built a distributed model using TensorFlow that processed 10M+ transactions daily, achieving 99.2% precision.  
- **Real-Time Trading Platform**: Developed PyTorch-based algorithms that increased ROI by 22% for ValueStream Analytics.  
- **Multilingual Sentiment Analysis**: Created an NLP pipeline processing 500K daily transactions, improving customer service efficiency.
